lines.trans: Sorry, Kaiwen, I got to work a little late today.
Xingzi and I were called back to the station today to present the revamp plan, so we will be out all day.

I heard that fan-club leader came to the company yesterday and confessed his feelings to you—is that true?
No way—who told you that?
Colleagues in Unit One all saw it, and the boss was right there at the time too.

Alright then, pretend I never asked—and if anything happens next, remember to tell me!
